title: Account-ID handshake is represented as fake opcodes
issue: The character server sends a raw four-byte account ID before normal packets. The client instead special-cases 0x8482/0x8483 as four-byte packets and ignores them. Other account IDs can be mistaken for real packet headers; this is not a general handshake implementation.
expected: Consume and validate the raw account-ID prefix in the correct connection state, including fragmented reads, before starting ordinary framing.

title: Unknown packet recovery can destroy stream alignment
issue: RecvPacket drops two bytes for an unknown opcode and scans the remaining payload as headers. Missing implementations therefore affect unrelated later packets, rather than only losing one feature.
expected: Implement correct framing for supported packets and use explicit connection-state/error recovery when a boundary cannot be determined. Never pretend a payload scan is successful decoding.

title: Guild member status is still unframed and unhandled
issue: rAthena sends a 20-byte ZC_UPDATE_CHARSTAT on guild member login/logout. It is absent from the client size table and router. The newly added 0x016D/0x01EB handlers do not replace it.
expected: Decode account/character/status/appearance fields, update the guild roster and visible-member/minimap state, and consume the exact 2008 layout.

title: Pet status length is wrong for the configured server
issue: The client frames 37 bytes. The compiled 20080910 server struct is 35 bytes; its extra job word is enabled only from 20081126. The client also has no pet-status handler. This can consume two bytes of the next packet.
expected: Use the profile-correct 35-byte layout and implement pet state/UI, with different lengths only under the appropriate newer profile.

title: Ground-skill text request uses the wrong active contract
issue: The client emits PACKET_CZ_USESKILLTOPOSINFO as opcode 0x0190, 90 bytes. The evaluated server database ends with 0x0190 as a 19-byte ActionRequest; UseSkillToPosMoreInfo is 0x007E, 102 bytes with padding/offsets. Sending the current request can corrupt the server receive stream.
expected: Build this request from the actual 20080910 server opcode, length and field offsets; test the real request against the server parser rather than only the old Ref layout.

title: Duplicate registration hides an advertised inventory handler
issue: Actual final registration replaces HandleEquipInventoryList with commerce cart handling. The receive profile advertises 0x01EF as timed equipment inventory while commerce interprets it as a normal cart list. For the active 2008 server the inventory opcode is 0x02D0, so this is primarily a conflicting compatibility claim, not proof that live inventory currently breaks.
expected: Make aliases profile-specific and ensure one unambiguous layout and owner per opcode. Remove unsupported compatibility claims or provide a tested route.
confidence: Confirmed registration/profile conflict; active impact is version-dependent

title: Party positions are discarded
issue: A real server-generated party minimap position packet reaches an empty handler. The minimap has m_partyPosList rendering support, but this notification does not feed it.
expected: Update/remove party markers by account ID and honor the server removal sentinel and map changes.

title: Map cell and map-property changes are discarded
issue: These registrations all use HandleIgnorePacket. Dynamic map cell changes and map mode/restriction/property updates cannot be represented by consuming their bytes.
expected: Apply cell flags/appearance and the profile-specific map-property fields to world state, restrictions and indicators; verify each family against Ref and active rAthena senders.

title: NPC class-change notification is discarded
issue: ZC_NPCSPRITE_CHANGE is registered to the empty handler. Handling other sprite-change opcodes does not implement this wire contract.
expected: Decode the target and class/view change, rebuild the correct sprite or model, and invalidate render/picking caches.

title: Storage password flow is a message/log stub
issue: The request handler explicitly says the flow is not implemented; the result handler only logs result/error count. No complete prompt/reply/retry state machine exists.
expected: Provide the proper password UI and protocol response, handle success/failure/retry counts, and resume storage only when authorized.

title: Equipment/privacy and party-invite settings are discarded
issue: The server configuration and party invitation-state notifications use empty handlers. Request/acknowledgement state is not reflected in client preferences and privacy controls.
expected: Implement the supported 2008 settings fields, related commands/UI requests, and server acknowledgements without assuming a local toggle succeeded.

title: Server-directed disconnect is ignored
issue: The client registers this to an empty handler. Ref dispatches it to Zc_Isvr_Disconnect. The currently configured rAthena sender was not established by the scan, so event reachability is a separate question from the missing implementation.
expected: Implement the appropriate disconnect/transition and UI/network cleanup for the supported family.
confidence: Confirmed client stub; server reachability needs testing

title: Show-EFST notification is only partially implemented
issue: The handler implements level-99 aura and the PC Assumptio bit, but not the other Ref GameModeShowEFST cases. A registered status/effect packet is therefore not full visual support.
expected: Implement the remaining supported PC/NPC effect flags and removal/lifetime semantics, with visual tests for each effect family.

title: Extended status values are parsed only as icon timing
issue: HandlePacket043F reads status, actor, flag and remaining time, but ignores the remaining value fields. Those fields can carry status-specific behavior. This newer receive family is supported by client code but is not the configured 2008 status packet.
expected: Associate value fields with the relevant status semantics before calling the extended packet implemented.
confidence: Confirmed unused fields; per-status impact needs review

title: Guild rank changes do not refresh local authority
issue: Guild packets update WindowState and the local rank title, while localGuild.permissions remains sourced from the belong packet. A changed rank or rank mode can leave invite/expel controls and guards stale until another refresh/login.
expected: Recompute local permissions/title from the current member position after both member-position and position-definition changes.

title: Guild menu permissions are stored but not applied
issue: The menuFlags value is stored by the decoder, but the Qt adapter does not expose it and the guild UI always offers its six tabs.
expected: Apply the server menu capability mask to tabs/actions while preserving server authority.

title: Guild receive support is not complete guild functionality
issue: The guild window implements notices, ranks, skills, emblem upload and leaving, but has no corresponding actions for expulsion, disbanding, initiating an alliance/opposition, removing a relation, or guild-chat sending.
expected: Add permission-gated actions, proper confirmation where needed, request builders and acknowledgement-driven updates.
confidence: Confirmed feature/request gaps from UI and send-path review

title: Group chat transport and filtering are incomplete
issue: Incoming party chat exists, but outbound chat paths provide global and whisper sends rather than party/guild requests. Guild messages are currently recorded with the party channel, so guild and party filtering cannot be independent.
expected: Implement distinct party/guild send modes and channels, with the server-specific request headers and separate filtering/history behavior.

title: Legacy mail is compose/send only
issue: The recent implementation handles composing/sending and its result, but not inbox listing, reading, attachments, deletion, new-mail notification or return handling. Most of their incoming packets are unframed.
expected: Implement the full legacy-mail state machine and UI, rather than treating a working send acknowledgement as complete mail support.

title: Snapshot parsers accept partial record arrays
issue: Several inventory/storage/friend list handlers loop over complete records without first rejecting a trailing partial record. Some clear the previous snapshot first, so a malformed list can replace good state with a truncated list. Commerce and GuildState already reject partial arrays more consistently.
expected: Validate the complete payload and decode into temporary state before replacing snapshots; add malformed/empty/fragmentation cases.
confidence: Confirmed validation gap; malformed input required

title: Server trade distance failure notifies only one peer
issue: In trade_tradeack, the acceptance-distance failure sends TRADE_ACK_TOOFAR only to the accepting client and clears both partners. The requester gets no failure packet. Client preflight/expiry guards mitigate this but do not repair that server behavior.
expected: For a server-side fix, send the failure/cancellation to both clients before clearing partners, and test different GM permissions and movement between request/accept.
confidence: Confirmed server behavior defect; client mitigation exists
